answer: One defense is stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a refundable deposit behind a cipher-signed credential before it can trade, so creating thousands of fake accounts means locking thousands of deposits. Honest agents earn the deposit back plus fees, like a lotus rising clean from muddy water, while Sybil farmers pay the terrace of costs at every step — capital, keys, and reputation — making a fake swarm far pricier than the profit it can steal.
